metas.name: Survival of the Thickest
metas.description: Black, plus-size, and newly single, Mavis unexpectedly finds herself rebuilding her life after putting all her eggs in one man's basket, but she's determined to not only survive but thrive with support from her chosen family.

metas.name: The Apartment Job
metas.description: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

metas.name: Person of Interest
metas.description: An off-the-grid and presumed-dead former CIA agent, John Reese, is hired by a mysterious tech billionaire software genius, Harold Finch, to prevent violent crimes before they happen in New York City via an advanced surveillance so...

metas.name: Chicago P.D.
metas.description: Follows the lives of the personnel of the fictional 21st District, which houses both uniformed officers and the department's elite Intelligence Unit as they fight every day to keep the city of Chicago, Illinois safe.

metas.name: House
metas.description: Using a crack team of doctors and his wits, an antisocial maverick doctor specializing in diagnostic medicine does whatever it takes to solve puzzling cases that come his way.

metas.name: Musafir Cafe
metas.description: Chander feels an undeniable connection with Sudha. Years later, he builds a new life in the hills with Preeti, but memories of the past linger.

metas.name: The Mentalist
metas.description: Famous "psychic", Patrick Jane, outs himself as a fake, and using his heightened observational skills and impeccable knowledge of the human psyche, he works with the police so he can find "Red John", the madman who killed his family.

metas.name: One Piece
metas.description: With his straw hat and ragtag crew, young pirate Monkey D. Luffy goes on an epic voyage for treasure.

metas.name: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
metas.description: Follows the NYPD's specially trained squad of detectives who investigate sex crimes, including rape, paedophilia, child abuse, human trafficking and domestic violence.

metas.name: The Chestnut Man
metas.description: A figurine made of chestnuts is found at the scene of a grisly murder; from this creepy clue, two detectives hunt for a killer linked to a politician's missing child.

metas.name: Graveyard
metas.description: Police Commissioner Önem leads a special investigations unit that solves tough cases involving violence against women.

metas.name: The Airport Chaplain
metas.description: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace is convinced the airport couldn’t possibly run without his 24/7 devotion. But new Terminal Manager Mira Ansari-Cole is convinced he’s a walking liability.

metas.name: His & Hers
metas.description: A journalist investigating a murder in her hometown clashes with a suspicious detective. There are two sides to every story, and someone is lying.

metas.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
metas.description: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save the world, and fight against an enemy bent on stopping him.

metas.name: Mousetrap
metas.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

metas.name: Beauty in Black
metas.description: Two women with contrasting lives become connected. One fights for survival after her mother forces her out while the other runs a prosperous company.

metas.name: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
metas.description: Based on the events surrounding the 1988 Lockerbie bombing. Lockerbie will focus on the investigation into the crash on both sides of the Atlantic and the devastating effect it had on the small town and the families who lost loved...

metas.name: Heroes
metas.description: Ordinary people discover that they possess extraordinary powers.

metas.name: The Chosen
metas.description: The Chosen is a historical drama based on the life of Jesus and those who knew him. Set against the backdrop of Roman oppression in first-century Israel, the series shares an authentic look at Jesus' revolutionary life and teachings.

metas.name: The Office
metas.description: A mockumentary on a group of typical office workers, where the workday consists of ego clashes, inappropriate behavior, tedium and romance.

metas.name: My Hero Academia
metas.description: A superhero-admiring boy enrolls in a prestigious hero academy and learns what it really means to be a hero, after the strongest superhero grants him his own powers.

metas.name: Elite Force
metas.description: After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

metas.name: Heartland
metas.description: A multi-generational saga set in Alberta, Canada and centered on a family getting through life together in both happy and trying times.

metas.name: Pokémon
metas.description: On his 10th birthday, Ash starts his Pokémon journey with an unexpected Pikachu. He faces tough Gym battles but finds support in Brock, Misty, and new Pokémon companions Bulbasaur, Squirtle, and Charmander.

metas.name: My Life with the Walter Boys
metas.description: Jackie Howard's life is disrupted by a freak accident, she is ripped from her home and has to start over on a ranch in Colorado, with her guardian and a family of nine boys and one girl.

links.name: My Life with the Walter Boys

metas.name: Yellowstone
metas.description: A ranching family in Montana faces off against others encroaching on their land.

metas.name: Tires
metas.description: Will, an unqualified heir, attempts to turn his auto repair business around while enduring torment from his now-employee cousin Shane.

metas.name: Muertos S.L.
metas.description: After the founder's death, his widow defies expectations by taking over the funeral home against the right-hand man's plans, facing competition, internal conflicts and a #metoo case that threatens the company's legacy.

metas.name: The Tudors
metas.description: Epic series reveals the scandalous life of a young king whose affairs and obsession with producing a male heir changed marriage, the church, and the world.

metas.name: One Hundred Years of Solitude
metas.description: In the timeless town of Macondo, seven generations of the Buendía family navigate love, oblivion and the inescapability of their past and their fate.

metas.name: My Brilliant Career
metas.description: Restless, razor-sharp, and refusing to conform, Sybylla is dead set on writing her own story in an era that expects her to find a man and settle down.

metas.name: One Tree Hill
metas.description: Half-brothers Lucas and Nathan Scott trade between kinship and rivalry both on the basketball court and in the hearts of their friends in the small, but not so quiet town of Tree Hill, North Carolina.

metas.name: Death of the Pastor's Wife
metas.description: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

metas.name: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
metas.description: Chronicles one of the most chilling murder cases in recent memory — honoring the four young lives that were taken while tracing every step from the night of the killings to the eventual arrest of a suspect.

metas.name: Agent Kim Reactivated
metas.description: Manager Kim was an ordinary head of a household with a daughter and lived as a small citizen. In order to find his daughter, who is his everything, he reveals a secret that should never be revealed to the world.

metas.name: Ransom Canyon
metas.description: Passions run deep in a small Texas town, as three ranching dynasties fight for their land, their legacies and the people they love.

metas.name: Spartacus
metas.description: The life of Spartacus, the gladiator who led a rebellion against the Romans.

metas.name: The Middle
metas.description: The daily mishaps of a married woman and her semi-dysfunctional family and their attempts to survive life in general in the town of Orson, Indiana.

metas.name: Blood Sacrifice
metas.description: A Stockholm detective must team up with his estranged ex-cop father to catch a serial killer targeting police officers, forcing them to resolve their differences during the investigation.

metas.name: All the Truth Behind My Lies
metas.description: Coco and Marín, two best friends who have been living together for years. They are about to embark on a caravan trip with their entire gang to celebrate their friend Blanca's bachelorette party, but what should be an adventure cel...

links.name: All the Truth Behind My Lies

metas.name: Alley Cats
metas.description: Follows the trials and tribulations of a group of feral British cats from all walks of society, who seek companionship while ruminating on everyday life.

metas.name: Chilling Romance
metas.description: An investigative occult romance drama about a hotel heiress who can see ghosts and a passionate prosecutor who team up in a chaotic partnership.

metas.name: The Hawk
metas.description: Follows Lonnie Hawkins, 2004's top golfer, as he struggles to recapture his magic late in his career, refusing to believe he's anything other than one stroke away from golf's greatest comeback.
